correctness.rationale: The Brownian backward heat equation yields the Green-kernel identity g(x)=D^{-1}∫min(x,y)f(y)dy, including singular renewal clocks by Tonelli. The renewal mean is g/f. The known conjugate p0=f0²/Z then admits an exact symmetric-kernel AM–GM deficit, nonnegative for all competitors and strict unless f=f0. Characteristic-function/Laplace uniqueness makes f=f0 equivalent to identical reset-duration laws. Finite reference mean follows from E τ0<∞ and Gaussian-tail integrals. The standalone checker passed 37 independent numerical assertions, not used for the all-law proof.

value.rationale: Establishes the missing global-minimization guarantee identified in the motivating research using an exact nonnegative deficit over the entire iid reset-law class. The theorem handles deterministic, exponential, mixture, singular and heavy-tailed competitor clocks and proves uniqueness by an intrinsic Brownian transform, resolving a structural protocol-selection question for random fixed targets.
